entries.title: [테크 차이나] 기업이 문제 내고 전국이 푼다…중국식 '공개 기술도전' 작동법 - 전자신문
entries.paragraph_1: 중국 국가 연구개발은 오랫동안 정부가 과제를 만들고 연구기관이 지원하는 방식으로 운영됐다. 문제는 연구가 성공해도 기업이 쓰지 않는 성과가 생긴다는 데 있었다. 산업이 원하는 기술과 공고문에 적힌 기술이 다르고, 연구자는 평가위원이 좋아할 논문과 지표를 우선할 수 있었다. 중국이 공개 기술도전과 복수팀 경쟁을 확대하는 이유는 연구비의 액수보다 '누가 문제를 내고, 누가 중간에 멈추며, 누가 성공을 판단하는가'를 바꾸기 위해서다. 한 문장으로 정리하면, 중국식 문제출제형 연구개발은 연구자를 선발하는 제도가 아니라 산업문제를 누가 출제하고, 어떤 마일스톤에서 중단하며, 최종사용자가 무엇으로 성공을 판단할지를 다시 짜는 운영체계다.
entries.paragraph_2: 먼저 공개 기술도전(揭榜挂帅)과 복수팀 경쟁(赛马制)을 구분해야 한다. 공개 기술도전은 기업·산업·최종사용자가 해결해야 할 문제와 성능지표를 공개하고 해결자를 모집하는 제도다. 복수팀 경쟁은 기술노선 불확실성이 큰 과제에 여러 팀을 병렬 지원한 뒤 마일스톤에서 계속 지원할 팀과 기술노선을 선별하는 방식이다.

entries.title: North Korea Won’t Give Up Nuclear Weapons, Kim’s Sister Says
entries.paragraph_1: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, Kim Yo Jong, has declared that the country’s status as a nuclear-armed state is “absolute,” dismissing hopes that Pyongyang could eventually surrender its nuclear weapons. Kim Yo Jong made the remarks on Thursday, insisting that North Korea’s nuclear status was permanent and could not be reversed through diplomatic pressure. North Korea has legally established itself as a nuclear weapons state, with its leadership maintaining that its nuclear arsenal is permanent and irreversible. Advertisement US President Donald Trump said in August that North Korea possessed 57 “very powerful” nuclear weapons, while South Korea has estimated the country’s arsenal at between 80 and 120 warheads. Kim Yo Jong’s comments came as South Korea said it was closely monitoring developments, particularly because Trump has recently raised the possibility of another meeting with Kim Jong Un. “The DPRK’s position as a nuclear weapons state is absolute which can not reverse with anything,” Kim Yo Jong said in a statement carried by the official Korean Central News Agency. Advertisement She argued that North Korea’s nuclear arsenal plays an important role in deterring what she described as hostile actions by other countries. Pyongyang’s nuclear weapons, she said, “makes a significant contribution to deterring the outrageous acts of international rogues.” Her remarks came during the General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) in Vienna, where she also dismissed renewed discussions about denuclearising North Korea. Advertisement Kim Yo Jong said the “familiar silly talk” about efforts to denuclearise the country was expected. “If they believe that it is really possible, they will only hear the word of idiots,” she said. She further insisted that neither political statements nor international opposition could alter North Korea’s nuclear status. Advertisement “No matter how rhetorically the hostile forces may deny, the reality in which the nuclear position of the DPRK has been permanently settled physically and legally cannot change even a bit,” she added, using the acronym for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, North Korea’s official name. A South Korean Unification Ministry official said Kim Yo Jong’s statement was significant because of its timing, coming amid renewed discussion about US-North Korea diplomacy. “We are paying close attention to Kim Yo Jong’s statement, as it comes at a time when US President Donald Trump has recently expressed his willingness to pursue dialogue with North Korea,” the official said, according to a transcript obtained by AFP. Advertisement Trump has repeatedly said he is open to restarting talks with Kim Jong Un and said last month that he planned to meet the North Korean leader later this year. Trump and Kim met three times during Trump’s first term, but their diplomatic engagement stalled following the 2019 summit in Hanoi. The Hanoi meeting ended without an agreement on sanctions relief or what North Korea would provide in return for denuclearisation. Onlangs leek de Amerikaanse president Donald Trump toenadering te zoeken tot Kim Jong-un. Beef Export Value Strong while Pork Exports below Year-Ago - Southeast AgNET
entries.paragraph_1: U.S. beef exports delivered another strong month in July, according to data released by the USDA and compiled by the U.S. Meat Export Federation . Export volume held steady at just over 89,000 metric tons, while export value climbed 6% from a year ago to nearly $797 million. Strong demand from Taiwan, Mexico, Japan, the Middle East, Colombia, the Caribbean, and Southeast Asia helped drive those gains.
entries.paragraph_2: USMEF President and CEO Dan Halstrom says global demand for U.S. beef remains resilient despite ongoing challenges in China. While exports in China remain well below previous years’ levels, growth in other international markets continue to support overall beef demand. For the first seven months of the year, beef exports totaled nearly 635,000 metric tons, valued at $5.5 billion.
